name: Lords Group Trading PLC
summary: Lords Group Trading PLC supplies a comprehensive array of construction materials, plumbing and heating equipment, and DIY products. Their diverse clientele spans local tradespeople, property developers, small to medium-sized construction firms, and individual retail purchasers. The company operates primarily through two divisions: Merchanting, and Plumbing and Heating. Beyond direct sales, they also serve independent merchants, professional installers, and the wider public with heating and plumbing solutions. Goods are made available through both physical and online sales channels. Founded in 1985, Lords Group Trading PLC is based in London, United Kingdom.
